name: image-inline
description: Shows the images a reply names (local paths, file:// and web URLs) under the reply

web.title: Web images
web.description: ask: a Load button under the reply for each web image. always: fetch them as soon as they show up (every URL a reply names is fetched with curl). local only: never fetch.

maxRows.title: Image height (rows)
maxRows.description: The tallest an image is drawn, in terminal rows.

maxImages.title: Images per reply block
maxImages.description: At most this many images under one reply block.
